g.title: Validates YAML structure, types, and required keys (C01).
Ensures IDs are unique and parents are valid L1 boxes (C02).
Validates that edge endpoints exist and are valid (C03).
Verifies that diagrams and viewer data match the model (C10).
Warns if a diagram exceeds recommended node count (C26).
